question: Can five completed rep0 cells with all stages, full parity, high-fanout closure and relevant regressions close original P8-006 while its registered1500 population is incomplete?
conservative_decision: No, under the currently selected and registered acceptance path. Accept the real correctness/attribution/first-repetition components; keep P8-006 in_progress.
reason_not_to_overstate: This is not a finding that P0 or original tasks eternally require exactly1500 samples. No such universal Cartesian lock was found in the bounded original-source review.

relevant_content.name: P0 current CodeCortex source DEV subset (20261003 semantic migration)

relevant_content.text: Exit 0 means the baseline measurement completed without integrity/availability failures, not that the engine is a high-quality retrieval system. Exit 1 means a product/gate failure; exit 2 invalid input/protocol/infrastructure; exit 3 explicit cancellation with a partial artifact prefix. Small-sample comparisons are inconclusive and nonzero. The smoke negative case intentionally exposes a current product failure.

Warmup and repetitions come from the locked suite, not hidden command defaults. `--profile performance` additionally requires a release-built eval binary, warmup and at least 200 rows. Product binary provenance must still be checked against its build receipt. Stage-boundary RSS is labelled sampled, not continuous peak RSS; external service memory stays unavailable unless independently measured. P0's source subsets and small mutations are not the P8 six-repository/100k/holdout certification.

P0_summary.scope: Explicitly inspected versioned query manifests/policy/usage, P0-IMPLEMENTATION and original P0 task references; not a claim to search every historical object.
